lines.zh: 我昂着头走，冠子一晃一晃。
lines.en: I walk with my head high, crest bobbing.

lines.zh: 两只脚交替得快，身子却稳。
lines.en: My feet move fast, my body stays steady.

lines.zh: 金色的冠子在草里很显眼。
lines.en: My golden crest stands out in the grass.
I peck the ground with each step.

lines.zh: 我翘着尾羽，沿篱笆巡一遍。
lines.en: Tail feathers up, I patrol along the fence.

lines.zh: 我踩在土上，留下一串三趾印。
lines.en: Three-toed prints trail behind me.
I skirt the pebbles, stepping lightly.
My tail feathers are cocked up.

lines.zh: 我穿过草丛，冠子先露出来。
lines.en: The crest shows first as I cross the grass.

lines.zh: 我小跑几步，翅膀拍了两下。
lines.en: I trot a few paces and flap twice.

lines.zh: 我低头啄了一下，又抬头。
lines.en: I peck once, then look up.
I walk the fence line, hunting bugs.
I stop and tilt my head at the ground.

lines.zh: 我踏过一片落叶，沙沙响。
lines.en: I step through fallen leaves; they rustle.
I walk with real swagger.
I ruffle my feathers and walk on.
I perch on the fence and survey the yard.
I tidy the feathers on my breast.
I lift one foot and tuck it.
I cluck twice.
Sunlight makes my crest shine.
Head tilted, I watch a bug crawl.
I shake and raise a little dust.
I spread my wings, then fold them.
This yard is my territory.
I turn slowly in place.
I lower my head and peck the dirt.
I squint, quite content.
I groom my back with my beak.
A gust bends my crest.

lines.zh: 我扑扇两下，跳上一块石头。
lines.en: Two flaps and I'm on a stone.

lines.zh: 我跳上木桶，清了清嗓子才叫。
lines.en: I hop onto the barrel and clear my throat before calling.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，冠子晃了晃。
lines.en: I look up at you and my crest sways.
You're standing in my yard.
Head tilted, I study your feet.
I cluck and take a step back.
My beak points at you.
Do you have food in your hand?

lines.zh: 我昂起头，把你上下量了量。
lines.en: I raise my head and size you up.

lines.zh: 我歪头，把你的靴子看了两遍。
lines.en: I tilt my head and give your boots a second look.
My neck feathers rise a little.
I'm not afraid of you, and I won't come closer.

lines.zh: 我拍拍翅膀，往上跳了一下。
lines.en: I flap and hop up once.

lines.zh: 我叫得很响，邻居都听见了。
lines.en: I crow loudly; the neighbors heard.
I flap and shriek.

lines.zh: 我扇着翅膀，半天没站稳。
lines.en: I flap and flap and still can't steady myself.
I lurch sideways, unsteady.
There's blood on my crest.

lines.zh: 我护着翅膀，往鸡舍里钻。
lines.en: I shield my wing and squeeze into the coop.

lines.zh: 我咕咕叫着，声音都变了。
lines.en: My cluck comes out wrong.
I dive under the fence.
That one went to the bone.
I shake and straighten up.
I can still run.
Seeds? I heard that.

lines.zh: 你手里撒下来的，是麦粒吧。
lines.en: What you're scattering looks like wheat.
I'm running over.

lines.zh: 我啄得快，怕你把手收回去。
lines.en: I peck fast, afraid you'll pull your hand back.
Lower your hand a little.

lines.zh: 这几粒，还不够我垫一口。
lines.en: A few grains like that barely touch my appetite.
I peck and keep an eye on you.
Don't pull your hand back yet.
I cluck, well pleased.
Even my golden crest looks brighter.
I hop to your boot.

lines.zh: 你的手指一动，我就凑上去。
lines.en: One twitch of your fingers and I'm right there.
That smells good.
I missed; let me try again.
Once I'm done, I'm leaving.
Anything left in your hand?

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我扑腾着跳开。
lines.en: You bump me; I flap and hop aside.
A feather comes loose.
I cluck, quite displeased.
The knock sends me sideways.
I flap to keep my balance.
You're so heavy, and I'm so small.
I back off and ruffle my feathers.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的冠子弄乱了。
lines.en: That messed up my crest.

lines.zh: 我抖开羽毛，重新昂起头。
lines.en: I shake out my feathers and lift my head again.

lines.zh: 我挡在鸡舍门口，你绕一下。
lines.en: I'm blocking the coop door; go around.
A hen is over there; I walk over.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀垂下来，绕着她转。
lines.en: I drop my wings and circle her.
I cluck softly.

lines.zh: 我啄起一粒谷子，又放下。
lines.en: I pick up a grain and set it down.
She lowers her head and pecks it.
I fluff my neck feathers, proud.
We walk side by side.

lines.zh: 她往谷仓去，我隔半步跟着。
lines.en: She heads for the barn; I follow half a step behind.
There's enough yard for us to scratch.
The sun's just right; I scratch the dirt beside her.
I peck up a seed.
I flick it over with my beak.
So small I nearly missed it.
I swallow it whole.
I snatch it and run.
Too hard; I can't peck through it.
I hide it in the grass.
I shake my head to shed the dirt.
A bit stuck to my beak.
I saw it first; I'll carry it off.

lines.zh: 麦茬里窸窣响，我停住脚。
lines.en: Something rustles in the stubble; I stop mid-step.
Head tilted, I fix on that direction.
My neck feathers rise.
I've stopped clucking.
I lift one foot and hold it.
That shadow looks wrong.
I open my wings slightly.

lines.zh: 我不叫了，只把眼珠转向那边。
lines.en: I stop clucking and roll one eye that way.
If it comes closer, I'll crow.

lines.zh: 我盯着它，脖子伸得很长。
lines.en: Neck stretched, I stare at it.
It keeps circling; I wait.
My head follows it.
Even my crest stands up.

lines.zh: 我贴着篱笆，一步步横着走。
lines.en: I edge along the fence, step by step.
It moves, and I crow.

lines.zh: 我的叫声把同伴都惊动了。
lines.en: My crowing startles the others.
It hasn't come closer.

lines.zh: 我伏低身子，冠子却翘着。
lines.en: I crouch low, though my crest still stands tall.
One step more and I peck.
I won't back off. This is my yard.
I lunge and peck.
The blow comes with a wingbeat.
I rake with my claws.
I hop up and ram.
My beak is hard.
I'm thrown back, feathers in disarray.

lines.zh: 我拍着翅膀，又冲了一次。
lines.en: I flap and charge again.
This much won't hurt you much.
Better to retreat to the fence.
I cluck, thoroughly annoyed.
I land on the grass and find my footing.

lines.zh: 金色的冠子在阳光里亮起来。
lines.en: My golden crest catches the sun.
I shake out my feathers.
This plain is wide.
First I peck the dirt.
There are bugs in the soil.
I raise my head and look around.
A few of my kind in the distance.
I crow once.
Then I walk over.
My feathers curl and I fly wildly.

lines.zh: 我从横杆上滑下来，摔得打滚。
lines.en: I slip off the perch and tumble over.

lines.zh: 水进了羽毛，我越扑腾越沉。
lines.en: Water soaks my feathers; the more I flap, the more I sink.

lines.zh: 气浪把我吹得翻了个身。
lines.en: The blast flips me over.

lines.zh: 箭羽刮过我的翅根，火辣辣的。
lines.en: An arrow's fletching grazes my wing root and stings.
Violet light makes my head swim.
My belly's empty and my crow is weak.

lines.zh: 雷落在篱笆外，我的冠子发麻。
lines.en: Thunder lands past the fence; my crest goes numb.

lines.zh: 我翅膀张着，却一直往下掉。
lines.en: My wings are spread, yet I keep falling.
